subject: RE: Post-demo next steps — Hosted capacity incident & migration options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Neal <jordan.neal@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Feb 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo next steps — Hosted vs Dedicated/Private

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — great conversation. Quick recap and recommended next steps from our side: 

- Current ask: you want low-latency inference for fronts-of-house fraud checks (avg request size ~800 tokens) and a hard requirement for 99.95% availability during trading windows.
- Today you’re on our Hosted API; you experienced the capacity blip last Tuesday during a large downstream traffic spike which impacted tail latency.
- Options: 1) increase Hosted capacity + stricter routing (short-term), 2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool, predictable throughput), 3) Private VPC / on-prem (regulatory/air-gap).

Recommended immediate path: short CTO-approved mitigation on Hosted while we scope a Dedicated migration — given the SLOs and the incident, Dedicated looks like the right target for predictable latency.

Next steps:
1) I’ll send an initial capacity proposal and migration plan by Monday.
2) Connor will help size Dedicated GPUs based on your QPS/sequence distribution.
3) If you need a private deployment, we’ll surface timeline and compliance checklist.

Attaching a preliminary pricing quote and a short migration plan. Can we schedule a 30-min call Monday to review sizing and procurement timelines? Suggested: Mon 3/2 9:30am PT.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments:
- redwood-pricing-quote.pdf (stub)
- hosted-to-dedicated-migration-plan.xlsx (stub)

From: Jordan Neal <jordan.neal@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Post-demo next steps — Hosted vs Dedicated/Private

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. Short answer: we need predictable latency by EoQ and the trading team is pushing HARD after last week’s outage — they want an umbrella SLA and predictable per-token economics.

A few clarifications:
- The outage last week caused ~3 minutes of elevated 95th/99th latency during a 10m window; ops flagged it as critical and we had to fall back to a cached heuristic which lost ~0.8% of transactions.
- Budget: we have some reserved CAPEX for Q2 procurement if the numbers look reasonable.
- Compliance: we will need SOC2 evidence and a data residency statement if we move to Dedicated or Private.

We’re available Mon 3/2 at 9:30 PT to review sizing. Also — can you confirm how fast a Dedicated standup could be? Ops needs an aggressive timeline.

—Jordan
Head of Platform, FinTechCo
jordan.neal@fintechco.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Post-demo next steps — Hosted vs Dedicated/Private

Looping you both in — Jordan reported a critical incident and is requesting predictable latency / SLA. Quick notes from sizing perspective:

- Based on their stated 800-token average and target throughput (they mentioned ~120 qps peak during trading windows), we should propose a Dedicated pool sized for sustained 150 qps to give buffer. That maps to roughly 8 A100-class GPUs with continuous batching and their token profile — will refine after they drop representative traces.
- Standup timeline: with committed purchase and expedited provisioning we can get Dedicated ready in ~3–4 weeks (provisioning, infra setup, smoke tests). Private VPC (customer-managed networking) adds another 2–4 weeks depending on network approvals and KMS integration.
- Short-term mitigation: bump Hosted route capacity and enable auto-fallback to a smaller model variant for low-latency critical path; that we can do in 24–48 hours.

I’ll prepare a draft SOW + SOC2 evidence bundle for procurement. Marissa — want me to include staged milestones (pilot on Dedicated, then full cutover)?

—Connor
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Neal <jordan.neal@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-demo next steps — Hosted vs Dedicated/Private

Jordan — thanks for the details. Quick answers inline: 

- Timeline: Connor estimate aligns with ours — Dedicated in ~3–4 weeks with expedited procurement; Private VPC is realistic but will need network approvals (add 2–4 weeks).
- SOC2: attaching evidence bundle we commonly share for procurement (redwood-soc2-evidence.zip).
- Pricing: attached a pricing quote for the Dedicated pool and a model for blended costs vs Hosted. We included a staged migration (pilot on half capacity for two weeks before full cutover).

Proposed next meeting agenda (30m):
1) Confirm sizing and pilot dates (Connor)
2) Walk through procurement checklist & SOC2 evidence (Laura)
3) Discuss SLAs and escalation playbook (Marissa)

Confirming our call: Tue 3/3 9:30am PT? If Monday 3/2 still better, we can keep that.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:

- soc2-evidence-stub.zip
- hosted-to-dedicated-migration-plan.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Post-demo next steps — Hosted vs Dedicated/Private

Jordan — Laura here (Head of Enterprise Sales Operations). Following up on procurement and compliance items: 

- I’ve attached a short SOW template and a procurement checklist. Once you confirm acceptance of the sizing and pilot dates, we can accelerate DocuSign and our provisioning queue.
- For SOC2: the attached stub contains the relevant controls and an evidence inventory; if you need encrypted logs or HSM-backed KMS, we can include that in the Private deployment pricing.
- Next steps for you:
  1) Confirm whether you want us to proceed with a Dedicated pilot or need Private VPC. If Dedicated, confirm pilot start window (we recommend 3/9–3/23 as pilot window).
  2) Share representative request traces (anonymized) and a short matrix of SLAs you need.

I’ll start a HubSpot deal task and attach the SOW + SOC2 bundle for your procurement team. Happy to jump on the call to walk through contract/PO flow.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
